transcript: Klasse 11 begins formal preparation for the oral exam ("Kommunikationsprüfung"). Mr. Yilmaz set the format: 4-minute monologue from a stimulus + 4-minute examiner dialogue + 2-minute closing. The class is rehearsing in pairs. Maja drew a stimulus card on the future of work; the dialogue partner is to ask one supportive and one sharp follow-up.
